newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BOURSE CLOSING: STRONG TRADE, TALSE HIGHER.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE CLOSING: STRONG TRADE, TALSE HIGHER.

text.p: * Preliminary data from the Estonian bourse on Monday put
total trade at 76.8 million kroons versus 51.8 million kroons.
* The Talse online index gained 1.57 percent to close at
267.05 (See index on stock exchange web site:
* Preliminary closing data put Hoiupank as most
active on 20.7 million kroons with a last deal price of 136.44
* Hansapank turned over 9.9 million kroons to be
higher on 142.90 kroons compared to 139.65 kroons.
